speaker: Narrator
text: The river tears at the rope bridge. Mira slips and goes under.

speaker: Tobin
text: Tobin dives after her and hauls Mira onto the bank, coughing. "I have you," he says, holding her above the water.

speaker: Wren
text: "I was never near your boat last night, Mira," Wren says, though the mud on Wren's boots says otherwise.

speaker: Mira
text: Mira looks at the boots, then at Wren, and edges away toward Tobin without a word.
